widgets.name: Calendar glance
widgets.description: Upcoming events (1 day to 1 month, default 1 week) from an iCal (.ics) link, with recurring events. Works with Google, Outlook, Zoho, Proton or a raw GitHub link.
widgets.author: AmineChr54

widgets.name: Claude waker
widgets.description: Sends a tiny "Hello" to the Claude CLI when you log in or your PC wakes from sleep, so your 5-hour usage window starts as early as possible. Or wake it with one click.
widgets.author: AmineChr54

commands.description: Sends "Hello" to Claude to start the usage window

widgets.name: Clock
widgets.description: A quiet, OLED-friendly clock with the date and a slim progress ring for the current minute.
widgets.author: AmineChr54

widgets.name: Countdowns
widgets.description: Count down to birthdays, trips and deadlines as dot grids, bars or rings, plus how far this year, month or week has gone. Add and edit right in the widget.
widgets.author: AmineChr54

widgets.name: Crypto price
widgets.description: Price, 24h change and a sparkline for any coin on CoinGecko.
widgets.author: AmineChr54

widgets.name: Quote or word of the day
widgets.description: A calm daily quote or word, in English or German. Built-in list, works offline.
widgets.author: AmineChr54

widgets.name: Event Radar
widgets.description: Your events, trips and deadlines as an agenda or a 3-month timeline. Type or paste lines like "Hackathon 26.10.-27.10." and they are sorted into the plan, with overlaps flagged.
widgets.author: AmineChr54

widgets.name: FreeCell
widgets.description: FreeCell on true black: eight columns, four free cells, click or drag cards and whole sequences, double-click to send a card home, unlimited undo, numbered deals and win streaks. Your game survives restarts.
widgets.author: Yacine-DH

widgets.name: Exchange rates
widgets.description: Euro against your chosen currencies with a 7-day sparkline. ECB rates via Frankfurter.
widgets.author: AmineChr54

widgets.name: GitHub Activity
widgets.description: Open pull requests, open issues, the latest CI run and the latest release of one public repository. Click a row to open it.
widgets.author: AmineChr54

widgets.name: Habits
widgets.description: Daily habits with a 52-week dot grid, current and best streak. One tap marks today; targets are daily or N times a week. Everything stays on your PC.
widgets.author: AmineChr54

widgets.name: Hearth
widgets.description: A cozy shared space for two people on two PCs. Pair once with a code, then add copies of this widget as an Overview strip, a drawing Board or a Pet. Needs the Umbra relay, which stores your names, dates, drawings and pet state (deleted 7 days after unpairing or after 30 days unused) and never your location.
widgets.author: Yacine-DH
widgets.changelog: A preview picture for Browse, the rounded Nunito font, and an Overview strip that fits its default size: the Tap button moved up beside the name, so nothing overlaps or gets cut off.

widgets.name: Internships
widgets.description: New international software internships from the speedyapply 2027 list, filtered to EMEA (or any region). Unread postings are marked and counted; click one to open it.
widgets.author: AmineChr54

widgets.name: Minesweeper
widgets.description: Classic Minesweeper on your desktop: left click to reveal, right click to flag, double-click a number to chord. Three board sizes, best times and win counts per size, and the game in progress survives restarts.
widgets.author: Yacine-DH

widgets.name: Now Playing
widgets.description: Shows what is playing in any media app (Spotify, browsers, VLC...) with album art and play, pause, next and previous controls.
widgets.author: AmineChr54

widgets.name: Pomodoro
widgets.description: A focus session like Windows Focus: pick the total minutes, optionally split into 22-33 min focus blocks with 5 min breaks, then follow the ring. Pause, skip, add 5 minutes, a toast at each phase change and a daily tally of focus minutes. Optional webcam timelapse of the whole session (replaces Study Time-Lapse). Survives restarts.
widgets.author: AmineChr54
widgets.changelog: New look: round play and pause controls, a reset button while paused, the menu moved next to them, a slimmer ring, and a timelapse card with a status pill and red recording dot. After a session ends you can still see its video being made.

widgets.name: Prayer Times
widgets.description: Daily prayer times with a live countdown to the next prayer, optional iqama times and Hijri date. Pick your city in the widget; times are calculated by coordinates with the Aladhan API (no key) and the method follows your country.
widgets.author: Yacine-DH

widgets.name: Quick Notes
widgets.description: A scratchpad on your desktop with up to five note tabs. Renders basic markdown as you type (headings, bold, lists), saves as you type and shows a character count. Everything stays on your PC.
widgets.author: AmineChr54

widgets.name: Script Runner
widgets.description: Run your own PowerShell, Python or Bash scripts from the desktop and see the exit code, time and output. Scripts are the commands declared in widget.json; you approve each one once.
widgets.author: AmineChr54

commands.run: powershell -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "$o = Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem; \"$($o.Caption) $($o.Version)\"; \"Uptime: $([int]((Get-Date) - $o.LastBootUpTime).TotalHours) h\"; \"Free memory: $([math]::Round($o.FreePhysicalMemory/1MB,1)) GB\""
commands.description: Example: prints the Windows version, uptime and free memory.

commands.run: powershell -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "Get-PSDrive -PSProvider FileSystem | Where-Object { $_.Used -ne $null } | ForEach-Object { \"{0}: {1:N1} GB free of {2:N1} GB\" -f $_.Name, ($_.Free/1GB), (($_.Used+$_.Free)/1GB) }"
commands.description: Example: free space on each drive.

commands.run: python -c "import sys, platform; print('Python', platform.python_version()); print(sys.executable)"
commands.description: Example: needs Python on PATH. Replace it with your own script.

widgets.name: Solitaire
widgets.description: Klondike solitaire on true black: click or drag cards, double-click to send one to a foundation, draw 1 or 3, unlimited undo, numbered deals, auto-complete and win stats. Your game survives restarts.
widgets.author: Yacine-DH

widgets.name: S&P 500
widgets.description: Live index price, daily change and a smooth intraday chart. Works with any Yahoo Finance symbol.
widgets.author: AmineChr54

widgets.name: Spider
widgets.description: Spider solitaire on true black: build K to A runs in one, two or four suits, click or drag whole runs, deal a row from the stock, hints, unlimited undo, numbered deals and win stats. Your game survives restarts.
widgets.author: Yacine-DH

widgets.name: To Do
widgets.description: Today's tasks with repeats, streaks and a calm progress bar. Right-click a task to mark it important, number your plan or move it to tomorrow. Keys: N add, arrows select, Space done, F2 or E edit, I, O, T, Del. Everything stays on your PC.
widgets.author: AmineChr54

widgets.name: Application Tracker
widgets.description: Track internship and job applications: company, role, status, date and follow-up. Status filters with counts, and due follow-ups highlighted. Add and edit right in the widget.
widgets.author: AmineChr54

widgets.name: Transit departures
widgets.description: Live departures for one Berlin stop (BVG and VBB) with delays. Uses the free v6.bvg.transport.rest API, no key.
widgets.author: AmineChr54

widgets.name: Weather
widgets.description: Temperature, condition and today's high and low for one city. Uses Open-Meteo, no API key.
widgets.author: AmineChr54
